name: Lynette Mirror
source:
A top bridal adviser for "Cupid Corporation" and the real goddess of love, Cupid.

Her father, the God known as Mars, had a disagreement on her method of work (how to use cupid arrows). This led  into a quarrel with her father.

In order to prove her beliefs, with the help of her aunt, the goddess Minerva, this ambitious goddess descended to the human world.

Recently her current obsession is to use the small electric current that flows between the horns of her divine creature called “Chi-chan” (who came along with her from the divine world she resided in) as a massage machine.
